_how_to_use: Fill BOTH lists for all 11 entries. phrases_seen -> data/seen_v2.jsonl. phrases_heldout -> data/held_out_v2.jsonl. They must describe the SAME square in DIFFERENT words.
_rules: It slots in after 'in' or 'to': 'put the bottle in ___' / 'move to ___'. Read it aloud.
One phrase = exactly one square. If a stranger with the map could point at two, rewrite.
A phrase must NEVER appear in both lists, and never in two different squares. The builder refuses.
held-out phrases should use different WORDS, not just different word order. That is the whole KPI.
_legend: rows A=far / B=middle / C=near (from the robot). cols 1=left / 2=middle / 3=right.

phrases_seen: the far left corner of the table
phrases_heldout: the upper left corner of the table
grid_A1._where: FAR (away from robot) row, LEFT column

phrases_seen: the far side middle edge of the table
phrases_heldout: the upper side middle edge of the table
grid_A2._where: FAR (away from robot) row, MIDDLE column

phrases_seen: the far right side corner of the table
phrases_heldout: the upper right side corner of the table
grid_A3._where: FAR (away from robot) row, RIGHT column

phrases_seen: the left side middle edge of the table
phrases_heldout: the left side edge from the table center

phrases_seen: the right side middle edge of the table
phrases_heldout: the right side edge from the table center

phrases_seen: the near left side corner of the table
phrases_heldout: the bottom left side corner of the table
grid_C1._where: NEAR (close to robot) row, LEFT column

phrases_seen: the near side middle edge of the table
phrases_heldout: the bottom side middle edge of the table
grid_C2._where: NEAR (close to robot) row, MIDDLE column

phrases_seen: the near right side corner of the table
phrases_heldout: the bottom right side corner of the table
grid_C3._where: NEAR (close to robot) row, RIGHT column

phrases_seen: the farthest spot you can reach
phrases_heldout: the maximum distance you can reach
max_reach._where: NOT a fixed square. The furthest square the arm can still reach. Backend resolves it.

nearest_free_cell._where: NOT a fixed square. Whichever square is empty and closest. Backend resolves it.
